components.name: Engine casing
components.description: Encloses compression, combustion and turbine stages.

components.name: Air intake
components.description: Guides incoming air toward the compressor.

components.name: Stationary compressor guide
components.description: Guides compressed airflow through the engine core.

components.name: Combustion chamber
components.description: Mixes fuel and pressurized air, releasing heat during combustion.

components.name: Turbine rotor
components.description: Extracts work from hot gas to drive the compressor shaft.

components.name: Central shaft
components.description: Couples turbine torque to the compressor rotor.

warnings: Schematic compressor and turbine discs, not true aerodynamically designed blades.
No air thermodynamics, fuel injection, thermal stress, thrust or fluid simulation.
